:::{#exm-coprecision}
#### The conditional precision and coprecision of a bivariate Gaussian vector

<!-- no-figure: scalar formulas for one 2 x 2 case; nothing to plot -->

Let $\vX = \tp{(X_1, X_2)} \sim \Normal_2\paren{\matr{0}, \pmat{1 & \rho \\ \rho & 1}}$
with $\abs{\rho} < 1$ (@exm-mvn-conditional).
With no other elements to condition on,
the [conditional variances](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-variance) are $v_1 = v_2 = 1$ and the [conditional covariance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-cov) is $c_{12} = \rho$,
so the [coprecision](#def-coprecision) of $X_1$ and $X_2$ is

$$
\frac{-\rho}{1 - \rho^2}.
$$

By @exm-mvn-conditional, $X_1$ given $X_2 = x_2$ has [variance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-variance) $1 - \rho^2$,
so the [conditional precision](#def-conditional-precision) of $X_1$ given $X_2 = x_2$ is

$$
\frac{1}{1 - \rho^2}.
$$

:::
